knownFacts.statement: The winning workflow began with a small amount of information and a logo.
Fable 5 produced a finished-looking, high-quality application mockup.
The operator showed the mockup at the first client meeting.
The client requested no design edits.
The guide records that the quality and preparedness helped close the deal.
A later Agency OS CLI test for Khatuna was submitted with Iraqi Arabic notes, but its two in-flight results were not observed and may have been lost with the in-memory server.
